description: (K)₂NaSmCl₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight K clusters inside a NaSmCl₆ framework. In each K cluster, K is bonded in a distorted cuboctahedral geometry to  atoms. In the NaSmCl₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SmCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Sm is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form SmCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sm-Cl bond lengths are 2.69 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Sm atom.
